name: Honcho
description: Honcho by Plastic Labs gives agents a long-term memory of you that other AI tools you connect can share. Agents save what they learn, and Honcho reasons over it to build a model of your preferences, goals and ways of working. Agents ask it questions before they start. OpenBot agents keep their own memory too; Honcho is the memory that follows you to other tools. Messages that agents save go to your Honcho account.

prompts.text: Ask Honcho what it knows about how I like to work before we start.
Save the decisions from this thread to Honcho.
What does Honcho say about my writing style? Use it for this draft.

apps.name: Honcho
apps.description: Save and query long-term memory in your Honcho workspaces over one MCP server.
